title: golden session 3: the long road (adolion-saga, Artemis)
objective: v2.8 24 golden session GS3. One adolion-fresh lane with Artemis v1.1 at 32K (3090 or pod), shipped defaults (thinking and inner voice on, judge on TypeSafe, authoring on Sol), images and sprites off. Story adolion-saga (the whole campaign in one chat: many voices, NPC replies, cast changes, preset effects, a schedule, a clock, living on) in its own group, picked by id; checkpoints are found by structure, never by name; player lines are generic. 18 real player turns plus OOC lines. Run twice back to back on one lane, run 2 from the seeded snapshot. Written, validated by the loader, not run yet.
